instruction: This test workflow verifies that the Gotham runtime correctly detects when Codex CLI is unavailable and automatically falls back to using the Copilot CLI instead. The system should perform a runtime probe, detect that Codex is not available, select Copilot as the fallback, and execute the workflow using the Copilot invocation contract. This ensures that the orchestration system is resilient and continues operating even when the primary model provider is not available.
